docs.fr: Appel à l’action et résultats
docs.text: From 2021 to 2024, what organizations reported moved from training and plans to sponsorship and data. Most recruitment goals were set by organizations already at or above availability, and the group most often below availability was outside the goal question. Where organizations reported bias or anti-racism training, fewer racialized employees said they faced bias in staffing. Where organizations reported self-identification campaigns, representation of persons with disabilities rose more. Where 2021 letters described leadership or talent development programs, employees’ views of the Call to Action fell more by 2024. Where organizations named Black employees in their documents, more employees overall said the Call to Action had a positive impact, and fewer Black employees did. Where a racialized recruitment goal was set, racialized employees were as likely as their colleagues to see opportunities for promotion. Where organizations reported an employment systems review, more employees said the Call to Action had a positive impact. Representation changed by about the same amount after 2023 whether or not an organization had set a recruitment goal. Organizations that described targeted recruitment in 2021 did not see clearly larger gains in representation or hiring. Organizations that reported sponsorship programs did not show clearly better views of promotion opportunities among racialized or Black employees. docs.textFr: De 2021 à 2024, les déclarations des organisations sont passées de la formation et des plans au parrainage et aux données. La plupart des objectifs de recrutement ont été fixés par des organisations qui atteignaient déjà la disponibilité, et le groupe le plus souvent sous la disponibilité ne faisait pas partie de la question sur les objectifs. Là où les organisations ont déclaré de la formation sur les préjugés ou la lutte contre le racisme, moins d’employés racisés ont dit avoir fait face à des préjugés en dotation. Là où les organisations ont déclaré des campagnes d’auto-identification, la représentation des personnes en situation de handicap a augmenté davantage. Là où les lettres de 2021 décrivaient des programmes de perfectionnement en leadership ou de gestion des talents, l’opinion des employés sur l’appel à l’action a reculé davantage en 2024. Là où les organisations nommaient les employés noirs dans leurs documents, plus d’employés dans l’ensemble ont dit que l’appel à l’action avait eu une incidence positive, et moins d’employés noirs l’ont dit. Femmes dans la fonction publique
docs.text: Main findings Principaux constats Women are 56.8% of the core public administration (151,528 employees as of March 31, 2025), above their workforce availability estimate of 54.9%. The overall figure hides differences. The findings below show where women who also belong to another group report different experiences, and where the published data stops. Les femmes représentent 56,8 % de l’administration publique centrale (151 528 employées au 31 mars 2025), au-dessus de leur estimation de disponibilité au sein de la population active de 54,9 %. Ce chiffre global cache des différences. Les constats ci-dessous montrent où les femmes qui appartiennent aussi à un autre groupe font état d’expériences différentes, et où s’arrêtent les données publiées. Women are the majority of each other designated group: 62.1% of Indigenous employees, 60.4% of persons with disabilities, 57.3% of members of visible minorities and 57.3% of Black employees are women (March 31, 2025). Results published for those groups describe groups that are mostly women. See the figures . In the 2022 employee survey, 19% of women with a disability said they had been harassed at work in the past 12 months, compared with 9% of women without a disability. For discrimination, the figures were 15% and 6%. See the 2022 results

Equity across the public service Where the data agree Government sources measure equity in different ways: who works where, what employees say in two separate surveys, and who gets hired. This page puts them side by side for every federal organization to find patterns that no single source shows. A pattern tells you where to look first. It does not prove discrimination, and it does not tell you what happened to any one person. Sources: Treasury Board workforce data to March 31, 2025; Public Service Employee Survey, 2019 to 2024; Staffing and Non-Partisanship Survey, 2025; Public Service Commission staffing data.
